## Reproduction and intent

Show a minimal fictional input, expected and actual behavior and why it improves the public workflow model.

## Regression checks

- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run demo`, `npm run replay` and `npm run record` pass or exact failures listed
- [ ] New or changed guards include positive and negative tests, including immutable denied paths
- [ ] Browser UI updates are tested with real Chrome against staged public Pages source, or limitations disclosed
- [ ] No external system, telemetry, credential, private history or unlicensed asset introduced
- [ ] No unsupported claims of secure authorization, live hosting, WCAG certification or production readiness

## Compatibility and provenance

Explain any saved-journal format change, public API change, new dependency or source-rights consideration.
